name: Chat health
ownerWords:
keep monitoring all the usage patterns of the Chat feature for that day, and periodically refine the framework so same stupid errors don't happen again.
now, this is a common patter, i want you to deep-research what to do. i want it to be owned by Chat though, maybe in a Cron/heartbeat tab within it with semantic goal defined
goal: Chats never sit stopped, never repeat themselves, and the owner never gives the same correction twice.

metrics.label: Hours a chat sat on a failed turn
Failed turns not retried in 25 min
Text on wakes the owner did not start

onMiss: Start one job that reads the details file, judges each flagged item, and routes each fix: the chat brief (send the owner's words to the realtime layer thread), code with a unit test in components/user-history/test, or a skill. Each fix names the metric it must move.
